{{- $index := slice -}} {{- range .RegularPages -}} {{- $section := slice -}} {{- $next := .Parent -}} {{ if and $next (not (eq $next.Title "Docs")) (not $next.IsHome) }} {{- $section = slice $next.Title | append $section -}} {{- $next := $next.Parent -}} {{ if and $next (not (eq $next.Title "Docs")) (not $next.IsHome) }} {{- $section = slice $next.Title | append $section -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* All regular pages, including adapted OpenAPI groups, supply their own .Content. */ -}} {{- /* Include fragment IDs so anchors are searchable even when not visible in .Plain. */ -}} {{- $anchors := delimit (findRE `\sid="[^"]+"` .Content) " " | replaceRE `\sid="([^"]+)"` "$1" -}} {{- $index = append (dict "sections" $section "title" .Title "tags" .Params.tags "description" .Description "categories" .Params.categories "content" (printf "%s %s %s %s %s" .Title .RelPermalink .Description .Plain $anchors | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace) "search_sections" (partial "search/content-sections.html" .Content) "url" .RelPermalink ) $index -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* hugo-flexsearch 1.0.2 expects the trailing hash record and excludes it from indexing. Share this hash with the HTML search widget. */ -}} {{- $hash := sha256 ($index | jsonify) -}} {{- return (dict "hash" $hash "index" (append (dict "hash" $hash) $index)) -}}
